title: Check Spec
description: Declarative, repeatable definition of one browser check. Executed identically against Baseline (merge-base render) and Candidate (feature branch render) by browser-verify.mjs. Ephemeral — lives in excluded docs/browser-checks/ scaffolding, never committed.

role.description: Named identity from the repo's Auth Profile (e.g. 'admin', 'firm', 'trial', 'anonymous'). Determines which stored state file browser-verify.mjs loads before running steps.

viewports.description: Ordered list of viewports to run the spec against. Each viewport produces its own Baseline/Candidate pair per capture step.

name.description: Stable viewport identifier referenced by visual-verdict (e.g. 'desktop', 'mobile').

steps.description: Ordered steps executed identically on Baseline and Candidate. Must include at least one goto and one capture.

url.description: Absolute URL or path-relative URL (base_url is prepended by the runner). Example: '/dashboard' or 'http://localhost:5173/dashboard'.

oneOf.description: Click an element by role/text locator.

locator.description: Playwright locator expression (e.g. 'role=button[name="Submit"]', 'text=Sign in', 'css=.nav-link'). Prefer role and text locators over CSS for resilience.
Playwright locator for the input field.

value.description: Text to type into the field.

oneOf.description: Wait for a condition before continuing.

condition.description: Wait target. Supported values: 'networkidle', 'load', 'domcontentloaded', or a CSS selector string (waits for the element to be visible). Example: 'networkidle' or '.dashboard-loaded'.

oneOf.description: Capture a screenshot at this point for visual comparison.

name.description: Stable identifier for this capture point. Used as the capture_ref in visual-verdict and as the filename stem for Baseline/Candidate PNGs. Must be unique within the spec (e.g. 'hero', 'nav-bar', 'modal-open').

oneOf.description: Assert a condition about the page. Failing an expect step always blocks the task.

locator.description: Playwright locator for the element under assertion.

assertion.description: Assertion type. 'visible': element is present and visible. 'hidden': element is absent or invisible. 'text': element's textContent matches value. 'count': count of matching elements equals value.

value.description: Expected value for 'text' and 'count' assertions. Omit for 'visible' and 'hidden'.

masks.description: CSS selectors for dynamic page regions to blank out before visual comparison (e.g. timestamps, avatars, live counters). Applied identically to Baseline and Candidate.

selector.description: CSS selector for the region to mask. The runner fills matched elements with a solid color block before taking the screenshot.

expected_visual_change.description: Declared intent: 'none' if no visual change is expected (triggers the zero-diff shortcut when diff is under noise threshold), 'present' if a deliberate visual change was made, null for derived checks where intent is unknown (any visible change resolves to needs_eyes).
